#!/usr/bin/env toolang 

# This file is designed for `toolang invoke` experiments.
# It keeps the capabilities minimal and focuses on different thunk shapes.

struct Summary:
  title: string
  summary: string

struct BulletList:
  items: string[]

thunk summarize(_) -> Summary:
  Produce a compact summary with a short title and a short summary paragraph.

thunk bullets(_) -> BulletList:
  Extract the main points into short bullet items.

thunk rewrite(_, tone?, audience?):
  Rewrite the input in the requested tone.
  Adjust depth and wording for the requested audience when it is provided.

thunk slug(title) -> text:
  Convert the provided title into a concise lowercase slug.
  Use hyphens between words and return only the slug text.
